protocol_metadata.about: NAVI is the leading one-stop liquidity protocol on Sui, enabling users to lend and borrow cryptocurrency assets directly through a shared liquidity pool system. The protocol supports SUI, USDC, USDT, wETH, and wBTC with advanced features including isolation markets, leveraged vaults, flash loans, and cross-chain lending. NAVI uses the Move programming language with security-first architecture including multi-provider oracle integration, supply limits, debt ceilings, and automated liquidation mechanisms.
